text:
Maria D.: Quick sync — we need to triage customer-driven asks for console observability. Key areas: dashboards, tracing hooks, token/cost breakdown, error analytics. Can we agree a minimal GA checklist vs stretch?
Raj P.: +1. Need to capture customer stories (fintech, platform ops, growth analytics) so we can prioritize RBAC/retention requirements.
Sam (PM): Proposed GA acceptance: basic dashboards (per-model, per-route latency & traffic), tracing hook to link request->model pipeline, cost breakdown at request & token level, and basic error analytics (classification by infra/model). Must include RBAC and configurable retention.
Lucy (Eng): Implementation notes: tracing hooks will be lightweight span headers we inject & emit to OTLP. We can add token_count as a span attribute. Concern: KV cache masking token attribution for cached prefixes.
Elena (CS): Customers repeatedly ask for per-API-key and per-environment cost slices + alerting for sudden cost spikes and quality regressions. BankCo asked explicitly for 12mo retention and on-prem export.
Tom S.: Recommend adding an eval hook that links prompt sets to traces so we can attribute quality regressions to model/version changes — useful during canary rollouts.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: obs-collector v1.3 -> staging @ 2026-04-02T09:00Z (#build 1234).
Raj P.: Prioritization (rough): MUST = per-route dashboards, per-API-key cost, trace hook with token attribution, RBAC. SHOULD = error analytics with automated buckets (rate-limit, infra, model-misgen). COULD = eval-linked regression alerts, long-term retention for enterprise.
Lucy (Eng): Rough effort: MUST ~ 4 sprints (runtime + ingest + UI), SHOULD ~ 3 sprints, COULD ~ 2 sprints. We need to negotiate GA scope if Q2 target stays.
Maria D.: Top customers driving this: BankCo (enterprise, retention/on-prem), AdSaaS (growth metrics, per-route costs), VideoAI (throughput/latency traces). Flag BankCo as enterprise blocker for longer retention.
Elena (CS): BankCo legal: SOC2 + KMS for export. They may shift to Private deployment if GA doesn't meet retention/compliance.
Tom S.: Workaround for GA: provide an encrypted S3 export of traces & indexed CSVs (customer-controlled KMS) while we build on-prem packaging.
Raj P.: Decision draft: Ship GA with 90-day retention + export tooling for enterprise customers, include RBAC and token-level cost attribution. Enterprise 12mo retention & on-prem as follow-ups (sales-driven).
Lucy (Eng): Implementation sketch: header = `x-rdwd-trace-id`, span attrs = {"token_count","model_id","seq_len","quant_profile"}, emit to our collector with minimal per-request overhead. Frontend: add "Costs" tab (filter by API key, model, route), "Traces" tab (time-range + model version + error-type). Example header: ```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  x-rdwd-trace-id: 0b12f4
  Authorization: Bearer <key>
```
Sam (PM): Launch acceptance tests: dashboard load p95 < 200ms; trace instrumentation adds <= 10ms p50; cost attribution within 3% of billing; RBAC works for basic roles. Owners: eng-runtime (tracing), eng-platform (dashboards), product (acceptance).
Elena (CS): I’ll draft beta comms and collect BankCo/AdSaaS VideoAI for early access.
Raj P.: Next steps: Lucy to write RFC by EOW (include perf budget + storage estimates), Sam to update roadmap & mark as "customer beta" for sales, Elena to compile beta list. We'll reconvene next Tue. :thumbsup:
Lucy (Eng): Noted. I'll include storage calc (90d prod ~= 2.5TB/day at current traffic) and retention toggle in the RFC.
Maria D.: Thanks all — this is the right balance. If anyone has major objections to the GA scope, shout now or in the RFC thread.
